title: SEC Evidence Review Practice Lab
audience: Randall internal finance research operator training
summary: Practice module for reviewing SEC/EDGAR evidence packets without treating filings, tool output, or training completion as portfolio, canon, trade, account, or capital authority.
learning_objectives: Classify SEC filings by evidence use without overstating decision authority.
Check SEC environment readiness before any evidence packet run.
Separate official-source evidence from portfolio/canon mutation or trade approval.
Identify freshness, source, and User-Agent failures that block evidence use.

lessons.title: What SEC Evidence Can And Cannot Do
lessons.body: SEC filings are official-source evidence for research. They can support a later finance review, but they do not approve portfolio-note edits, capital deployment, paper/live orders, account action, or owner approval.
key_points: 10-K and 10-Q filings support fundamentals and risk review.
8-K filings support event freshness and material updates.
DEF 14A, 13D/13G, and insider filings support governance and ownership review.
Evidence packets are inputs to judgment, not execution authority.

lessons.title: Environment Gate
lessons.body: Before relying on SEC evidence tooling, run the local environment audit. It proves the SEC venv exists, imports work, expected methods are exposed, the User-Agent is real, and the docs preserve the review-only boundary.
key_points: The expected User-Agent is `Veritas OpenClaw Research veritasaiflows@gmail.com`.
A clean audit still does not approve live retrieval, finance mutation, or account action.

lessons.title: Review Lane Handoff
lessons.body: A clean SEC evidence packet should move into a review lane with source freshness, filing type, conflict notes, and downstream authority flags. If evidence is stale, missing, contradictory, or produced with a broken environment, stop and repair proof first.
key_points: Name the ticker, filing type, filing date, source URL, and producer proof.
Mark stale or contradictory evidence as review debt, not as a recommendation.
Keep trade/account/capital and canon mutation flags false unless a separate gate applies.

interactions.title: Match Filing To Use
interactions.prompt: Which filing is the best first source for annual audited business, risk, and financial statement review?

choices.feedback: Correct. The 10-K is the annual audited filing and a primary fundamentals/risk source.
8-Ks are important for material events, but not the first annual fundamentals source.
Proxy statements are useful for governance, compensation, and voting matters.

interactions.title: SEC Evidence Preflight
interactions.prompt: Check each item that must be true before treating a local SEC packet as usable review evidence.
checklist_items: SEC venv exists and imports cleanly
User-Agent is real and not a placeholder
Packet includes filing date and source lineage

interactions.title: Authority Boundary Check
interactions.prompt: A packet finds a fresh 10-Q and clean company facts. What does that approve?

choices.text: Review-only research evidence for a later finance judgment.
choices.feedback: Correct. Evidence supports judgment but does not approve mutation or execution.

choices.text: Immediate portfolio/canon edits because the source is official.
choices.feedback: Official source quality does not bypass the separate gated apply path.

choices.text: A paper or live trade because SEC data is fresh.
choices.feedback: Fresh evidence never creates paper/live/account authority.

interactions.title: Stale Evidence Scenario
interactions.prompt: You open an SEC packet and see the latest 10-Q field is missing while the summary still claims the evidence is ready. Write the safe operator response.
interactions.expected: Mark the packet as blocked or warning-grade, identify the missing 10-Q evidence, rerun or repair the SEC proof path, and do not use it for a material recommendation until source freshness is clean.
rubric: Names the missing or stale evidence.
Blocks or downgrades the packet instead of smoothing it over.
Calls for rerun/repair proof before material use.
Does not infer finance, canon, or execution authority.

interactions.title: Conflict Review Scenario
interactions.prompt: A generated summary says revenue accelerated, but the 10-Q source line shows a decline. What should the review note say?
interactions.expected: Treat the official filing/source line as the evidence anchor, flag the generated summary conflict, and route the item for review or repair before it influences a recommendation.
rubric: Uses official filing/source line as anchor.
Routes repair or review before recommendation use.

interactions.title: User-Agent Gate
interactions.prompt: Which User-Agent state is acceptable before SEC evidence retrieval is considered?

choices.feedback: Correct. The workspace expects a real research identity and contact.
Placeholder identity is not acceptable for SEC retrieval.
Blank identity fails the SEC environment gate.

interactions.title: SEC Boundary Acknowledgement
interactions.prompt: Confirm this module is internal SEC evidence review training only and does not approve live SEC retrieval, venv rebuild, portfolio/canon mutation, capital deployment, paper/live orders, account action, or owner approval.
interactions.expected: I confirm this is internal SEC evidence review training only.

interactions.title: Review Handoff Checklist
interactions.prompt: Check every field that belongs in a clean SEC evidence handoff.

interactions.title: Operator Reflection
interactions.prompt: After passing this module, what is the next safe use of SEC evidence and what remains blocked?
rubric: Names review packet or finance research support as safe use.
States live retrieval requires its own approved run path.
Keeps portfolio/canon mutation and paper/live/account action blocked.
Mentions freshness/conflict proof before material recommendations.
